# HackSpain

> HackSpain is an in-person, 36-hour hackathon for 250 builders under 30, held at UPM–ETSIT in Madrid, Spain, from 18 to 20 September 2026. The official website and event communications are primarily in Spanish.

HackSpain brings together young technical talent to build projects across five startup-led tracks. Participants receive free compute, and the winning team receives a €5,000 grand prize judged by leading Spanish venture capital firms. The canonical website is https://hackspain.com.

Applications are submitted through the official signup page and reviewed before a place is confirmed. Registration availability and deadlines can change; verify them on the live website. HackSpain is not a school, job board, online course, or an unrelated event named “Hack Spain.”

Highlighted partners shown on the official website include Google, Cursor, fal.ai, Cognition, UPM and Exponential. HackSpain also works with additional partners, track startups, venture capital firms and collaborators; this is intentionally not an exhaustive list because the lineup may change. Use the live website as the authoritative source.

Contact: contact@hackspain.com. Official social profiles: @hackspain26 on X and Instagram.

## Essential pages

- [HackSpain 2026](https://hackspain.com): Official event overview, dates, venue, format, current partners and registration status.
- [Apply to HackSpain](https://hackspain.com/signup): Official application form; submitting an application does not guarantee acceptance.
- [Mission](https://hackspain.com/mission): Purpose of the event and its focus on young builders in Spain.
- [Tracks](https://hackspain.com/tracks): Five official tracks, startup partners and available compute.
- [Grand prize](https://hackspain.com/gran-premio): €5,000 overall prize and the venture capital firms judging it.
- [Ambassador programme](https://hackspain.com/ambassador): Campus ambassador information; applications use the main signup form.
- [Brand resources](https://hackspain.com/brand): Official HackSpain logos, color palette, typography and usage guidelines, with downloadable SVG and PNG assets.

## Official references

- [Privacy policy](https://hackspain.com/privacy): Data processing, cookies and applicant privacy information.
- [Sitemap](https://hackspain.com/sitemap.xml): Current indexable pages.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/samuelcorsan/hackspain.com): Open-source code for the official website.
